name: Proof-of-address check
description: Read utility bills and statements, extract name, address and date, check them against the application and show the analyst any doubtful field

name: Identity document check
description: Read passports and driving licences, extract and check the fields, and flag expired or blurred documents

name: Business account pack
description: Read company documents and cross-check directors and owners against the Companies House register

name: Applicant follow-up drafts
description: Draft the 'ask applicant' message with the exact reason and what to send instead, for the analyst to approve

name: Automatic KYC decisions
description: Approve or reject applications without an analyst
excluded_reason: A person must make every KYC decision (MLRO, 06:50)
